svg.title: One task, from open to outcome
svg.desc: A core agent opens a task. The ambassador checks policy and admission, records its intent in the journal, sends the vendor request to the external system, records the outcome, sanitises what came back and answers with one of four outcomes. Admit: 1. Core agent calls Ambassador: open task. 2. Ambassador sends to Ambassador: policy, admission. Record, then act: 3. Ambassador sends to Journal: record intent. 4. Ambassador calls External system: vendor request. 5. External system replies to Ambassador: vendor reply. 6. Ambassador sends to Journal: record outcome. Answer: 7. Ambassador sends to Ambassador: sanitise, translate. 8. Ambassador replies to Core agent: one of four outcomes.
